responsibility: Performs C-family-specific lowering from front-end trees to GENERIC/GIMPLE-ready form. It genericizes structured control constructs such as loops, break/continue targets, and scopes into lower-level trees, applies shared tree-walk rewrites before SSA-oriented lowering, coordinates selected UBSan array-bounds instrumentation during genericization, and provides C-family gimplify hooks for expressions whose semantics need front-end-aware conversion before the generic gimplifier takes over.
